id: title:abhischekt:stop stripe enrichment renaming salesforce accounts

review.posthog_relevance: Salesforce Account enrichment and update workflow, specifically removing Stripe customer name and adding a guard against missing customer ID or billing address.
review.reason: The chunk removes Stripe customer name from Salesforce Account updates and adds a check to skip updates where customer ID or billing address is missing. This is a localized maintenance and behavior correction. The chunk lacks the complete Stripe enrichment workflow, Salesforce connector, and full workflow execution, preventing assessment of systemic risk reduction or broader impact
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on the provided chunk; complete implementation and systemic benefits are not demonstrated. No unverified outcomes inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the Stripe enrichment workflow, the Salesforce connector, or the full StripeSignals class definition. It also lacks the complete workflow execution and the full Salesforce bulk update implementation. This makes it impossible to assess the systemic risk reduction or broader capability demonstrated. The chunk is dominated by:

observations.behavior: Removes Stripe customer name from StripeSignals dataclass and its usage, while retaining Stripe customer ID and billing address.
observations.posthog_connection: The StripeSignals class is used to fetch and prepare Stripe customer data for Salesforce Account updates. Removing billing_customer_name removes the Stripe customer name from the Salesforce Account update payload.

observations.behavior: Removes Stripe customer name from the Salesforce Account update record preparation and its usage.
observations.posthog_connection: This assertion checks that the Salesforce Account record's Name field is populated. Removing billing_customer_name removes the Stripe customer name from the Salesforce Account update payload.

observations.behavior: Adds a check to skip Salesforce Account updates where the Stripe customer ID or billing address is missing, while retaining the Account ID.
observations.code_quote: update_records = [record for record in prepared_records if len(record) > 1]
observations.posthog_connection: This check prevents Salesforce Account updates where the Stripe customer ID or billing address is missing, while retaining the Account ID. This could prevent unnecessary Salesforce Account updates, but the implementation is not complete.
